blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automated assessment of the Critical View of Safety (CVS) in laparoscopic cholecystectomy requires both recognition of the three CVS criteria and anatomical grounding in small, rare, and often occluded hepatocystic structures. Learning-based methods differ in the anatomical information they use, from image-level classification to detection, segmentation, or graph-based reasoning, yet grounding the safety-critical anatomy remains the main bottleneck. We propose CasCVS-Net, a staged multi-task cascade that jointly performs object detection, semantic segmentation, and CVS assessment, trained on the Endoscapes dataset. The model couples the tasks through predicted anatomy: predicted boxes guide segmentation, and predicted masks provide region-level features for CVS classification, so CVS assessment at inference uses only model predictions rather than ground-truth annotations. To reduce optimisation instability in this coupled setting, training progresses from detection to detection–segmentation and then to the full three-task cascade, followed by task-wise fine-tuning. Evaluation on the public unseen test set shows that CasCVS-Net improves over matched single-task baselines on all three tasks, achieving 32.0 detection mAP, 46.8 semantic mIoU, 15.3 rare-anatomy mIoU, and 67.2 CVS mAP. It outperforms the state-of-the-art LG-CVS and SV2LSTG by 6.3% and 4.5% relative CVS mAP, respectively, corresponding to 4.0 and 2.9 mAP points. These results show that staged task coupling through predicted boxes and masks improves anatomical grounding for CVS assessment, particularly for rare hepatocystic structures.
blocks.zh: 对腹腔胆囊切除术中的安全临界视图(CVS)进行自动化评估,既需要承认CVS的三项标准,也需要在小的、稀有的、而且经常隐蔽的肝细胞结构中进行解剖。 以学习为基础的方法在它们使用的解剖学信息上有所不同,从图像级分类到检测,分解,或以图表为基础的推理,然而对安全关键解剖学的定位仍然是主要的瓶颈. 我们提议使用CasCVS-Net,这是一套分阶段的多任务级联,联合进行物体检测、语义分解和CVS评估,培训内容为远端景观数据集。 模型通过预测解剖学对任务进行配对:预测箱引导分解,预测口罩为CVS分类提供了区域层面的特征,因此CVS推论评估只使用模型预测,而不是地面真实说明. 为了减少这种组合环境中的优化不稳定性,培训从检测到检测-分级,再到完整的三任务级联,然后按任务进行微调。 对公共隐形测试集的评价显示,CasCVS-Net改进了所有三项任务的匹配单任务基线,实现了32.0 mAP,46.8 语义mIoU,15.3 稀有解剖mIoU,67.2 CVS mAP. 它的性能分别比最先进的LG-CVS和SV2LSTG高出6.3%和4.5%相对CVS mAP,对应4.0和2.9 mAP点. 这些结果表明,通过预测的盒子和口罩进行任务耦合,可以改善CVS评估的解剖基底,特别是对罕见的肝细胞结构而言。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Bile duct injury is among the most serious complications of laparoscopic cholecystectomy, occurring in roughly 0.3–0.7% of cases and carrying high morbidity and cost [ 4 ] . Many injuries arise from misidentification of biliary anatomy rather than technical execution alone [ 5 ] . The Critical View of Safety (CVS), introduced by Strasberg et al. [ 3 ] , aims to prevent such errors by requiring three conditions before division of the cystic duct or artery: only the cystic duct and cystic artery enter the gallbladder (C1), the hepatocystic triangle is cleared (C2), and the lower gallbladder is separated from the cystic plate (C3). Although reliable CVS achievement is associated with safer surgery [ 6 ] , CVS documentation remains inconsistent [ 7 ] , motivating automated assessment that is both accurate and anatomically grounded.
blocks.zh: 肠道损伤是大肠胆囊切除术最严重的并发症之一,在大约0.3-0.7%的病例中发生,发病率和成本都很高[4]。 许多伤害产生于对子体解剖学的误认,而不是仅仅技术处决[5]. 由斯特拉斯贝格等人介绍的安全临界视图(CVS). [3],目的是通过在囊管或动脉分裂前要求三个条件来防止这种错误:只有囊管和囊管动脉进入胆囊(C1),肝囊三角形被清除(C2),下胆囊与囊管板(C3)分离. 虽然可靠的CVS成就与更安全的外科手术[6]有关,但CVS文件仍然不一致[7],促使自动评估既准确又无解剖依据。

blocks.en: CVS assessment is commonly formulated as multi-label prediction of the three CVS criteria, and learning-based methods differ mainly in how they use anatomical supervision or representation. Segmentation-based pipelines segment the hepatocystic anatomy before classification [ 8 ] ; detection- and graph-based methods localise anatomy with bounding boxes and reason over the detected structures [ 9 , 10 ] ; other methods detect landmarks or safety zones for intraoperative guidance [ 11 , 12 ] ; and more recent transformer- or representation-learning classifiers operate directly at the image level [ 13 , 14 ] . Despite this progress, reliable anatomical grounding remains challenging, especially for the rare and small safety-critical structures such as the cystic plate and hepatocystic triangle, which are difficult to localise and segment. This motivates a detection-guided cascade, in which detection provides coarse localisation cues for segmentation, and segmentation in turn provides an anatomy-aware representation for CVS assessment.
blocks.zh: CVS评估通常被表述为对CVS三项标准进行多标签预测,基于学习的方法主要在如何使用解剖学监督或表述上有所不同. 基于分解的管道在分类前将肝细胞解剖分解 [8]; 检测和图表方法将解剖方法与捆绑的框和被检测结构的理由本地化 [9,10]; 其他方法检测用于操作内引导的地标或安全区 [11,12]; 更近期的变压器或表现学习分类器直接在图像一级运行 [13,14]. 尽管取得了这些进展,但可靠的解剖地面仍然具有挑战性,特别是对于极少数和小的安全临界结构,如囊状板块和肝囊状三角形,它们难以定位和分块. 这激发了一种探测制导的级联,在级联中,检测为分解提供了粗细的局部化提示,分解进而为CVS评估提供了解剖意识的体现.

blocks.en: We propose CasCVS-Net , a staged multi-task cascade linking object detection, semantic segmentation, and CVS prediction in a shared ResNet-50–FPN network with task-specific residual adapters. The framework is trained progressively: a detection head is trained first, and its predicted boxes are converted into class-aware spatial priors that guide training of the segmentation head; the predicted semantic masks then define the anatomical regions utilized by a mask-pooled CVS head. Because each head is trained on the same predicted boxes and masks it will receive at test time, the cascade needs no ground-truth boxes or masks at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们提议CasCVS-Net,这是连接物体探测、语义分解和CVS预测的分阶段多任务级联,在一个共享的ResNet-50-FPN网络中,有特定任务剩余适配器。 这个框架是逐步训练的:先训练一个探测头,然后将其预测的盒子转换成班级意识空间前科,指导分层头部的训练;然后,预测的语义口罩界定了面具集合式CVS头部所用的解剖区域. 由于每个头都训练在测试时会得到的相同的预测盒和口罩上,级联不需要地面真实盒或口罩来推断.

blocks.en: Our key contributions are: (i) a detection-guided segmentation cascade that uses predicted boxes as coarse priors for rare safety-critical anatomy; (ii) a mask-pooled CVS head that extracts region-level features from predicted semantic masks, keeping the training and inference pathways consistent; and (iii) an Endoscapes evaluation that reports detection and segmentation for the rare safety-critical anatomy separately, with ablations isolating staged training, box-to-mask guidance, and mask-to-CVS coupling.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是:(一) 探测制导分解级联,将预测的箱作为粗前科用于稀有的安全临界解剖;(二) 口罩集成CVS头,从预测的语义口罩中提取区域层面的特征,保持培训和推断途径的一致性;(三) 外景评价,分别报告稀有的安全临界解剖的检测和分解情况,同时将分解式培训、箱对面具制导和口罩对CVS组合隔离。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Given a laparoscopic frame, the model predicts object detections, a semantic segmentation map, and CVS criterion scores. Detection uses six foreground classes: cystic plate, hepatocystic triangle, cystic artery, cystic duct, gallbladder, and surgical instrument. Segmentation predicts the same six classes plus background. The CVS branch predicts the three criteria C1–C3.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个大肠镜框,模型预测物体检测,语义分解图,以及CVS标准分数. 检测使用6个前缘类:囊盘,肝细胞三角,囊脉,囊管,胆囊,外科仪器. 分化预测相同的六门课加背景. CVS分支预测三个标准C1-C3.

blocks.en: The model is a cascaded multi-task predictor with a shared ResNet-50–FPN encoder [ 16 , 17 ] and task-specific heads (Fig. 1 ), producing multi-scale pyramid features. Before each head, a lightweight residual adapter [ 19 ] refines every FPN level: a 1 × 1 1\times 1 then 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution with a ReLU between, the final layer zero-initialised and added back to the level’s features, so each adapter starts as the identity and learns only a task-specific residual. The three task adapters share this design but keep independent weights.
blocks.zh: 该模型是一个级联的多任务预测器,带有共享的ResNet-50–FPN编码器[16,17]和任务特定头(图1),产生多尺度金字塔特征. 在每头之前,一个轻量级的剩余适配器[19]精炼每个FPN级别:一个1×1的1\1\1 then1 then3\3\3\3volution3 con3 与一个ReLU之间的进化,最后一层零初始化,并加入到该级别的特点中,因此每个适配器开始作为身份,只学习一个任务特定的剩余. 三个任务适配器共享这个设计,但保持独立的权重.

blocks.en: The detection branch is a Faster R-CNN head [ 18 ] : a region proposal network generates candidate boxes on every pyramid level, and a region-of-interest head classifies and refines them into the six anatomy and instrument classes. The segmentation branch is a DeepLabV3+ decoder [ 20 ] , and the CVS branch is the mask-pooled head of Section 2.2 , each on its adapted features. At inference these heads form a cascade (Sections 2.1 and 2.2 ): the model maps a frame to boxes, then masks, then CVS scores using only its own predictions.
blocks.zh: 检测分支是一个更快的R-CNN头 [18]: 一个区域建议网络在每个金字塔级别产生候选箱,一个利益区域头级将它们分类和完善为六个解剖学和仪器类. 分块分支是DeepLabV3+解码器[20],CVS分支是第2.2节的口罩池头,每个分支在经过改造的特征上. 推论这些头组成了级联(第2.1和2.2节):模型将一个框架映射到盒子上,然后是面具,然后是CVS只使用自己的预测得分.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed staged cascade. A shared ResNet-50–FPN encoder produces multi-scale features, which are refined by task-specific adapters before the detection, segmentation, and CVS heads. At inference, predicted boxes guide segmentation and predicted masks define regions for CVS feature pooling.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议分阶段级联概览。 一个共享的ResNet-50–FPN编码器产生多级特性,这些特性由任务特定的适配器在检测,分区,和CVS头之前加以完善. 推论,预测框引导分割和预测口罩定义了CVS特性集合的区域.

blocks.en: 2.1 Box-to-Mask Coupling
blocks.zh: 2.1 箱对任务组合

blocks.en: 2.2 Mask-Pooled CVS Head
blocks.zh: 2.2 遮盖式CVS 头

blocks.en: Figure 2: Mask-pooled CVS head. The predicted semantic map is converted into hard class regions and downsampled to the CVS feature grid. Class-wise mask pooling extracts anatomical embeddings, while a spatial attention branch summarises global context. The concatenated representation is passed through fully connected layers to predict the three CVS criteria. Here B B denotes the batch size; the mask branch stacks one 64 64 -dimensional embedding per class ( 7 × 64 = 448 7\times 64=448 ).
blocks.zh: 图2:面具拼接式CVS头. 预测的语义图被转换为硬类区域,并下取样为CVS特征网格. 类掩体集合提取解剖嵌入,而空间关注分支则概括全球背景. 调和的表示通过完全连接的层来预测三个CVS标准. 这里的B表示批量大小;面具分支堆放每类一个6464维嵌入(7×64=448 7\times 64=448).

blocks.en: The second coupling lets the CVS head utilize the predicted anatomy rather than only global image features.
blocks.zh: 第二个组合让CVS头利用了预测的解剖学特征,而不仅仅是全球图像特征.

Stacking the per-class embeddings, one slot per semantic class including background, yields the mask feature.

blocks.en: In parallel, a soft spatial-attention branch pools the same features into a global summary: a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution reduces the feature map to a single-channel score, and a softmax over the grid gives the attention weights that sum the features. The per-class mask embeddings and this summary are concatenated and passed through fully connected layers to produce the three CVS logits.

blocks.en: Because the regions come from a hard arg ⁡ max \arg\max semantic map, CVS loss does not backpropagate through mask membership into the segmentation decoder. The coupling therefore uses segmentation as a structured anatomical representation, while CVS supervision updates the CVS branch and any shared features trainable in the current stage.

blocks.en: 2.3 Staged Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 2.3 分阶段培训战略

blocks.en: Training the three tasks jointly from scratch is unstable: detection, dense segmentation, and image-level CVS impose conflicting demands on the shared encoder, and a weak detector provides unreliable inputs to the downstream heads. We therefore build the cascade in four stages. (i) Detection: we train the Faster R-CNN branch alone to establish the localisation and multi-scale features the cascade depends on. (ii) Detection–segmentation: we add the segmentation branch and train it together with detection, warm-starting its head from a pre-trained single-task segmentation model; the FPN, both heads, the adapters, and the late ResNet stages update while the early stages stay frozen. (iii) Full cascade: we add the CVS head and train all three tasks together with both couplings active, so each head learns from the predicted boxes and masks it will see at inference (this stage uses the binary box prior of Section 2.1 ); PCGrad [ 15 ] removes the conflicting component of each task gradient on the shared backbone and FPN before the update. (iv) Fine-tuning: finally, we fine-tune the heads one at a time in cascade order (detection, segmentation, CVS). Each pass trains only that head and its adapter with the rest frozen, recalibrating it on the now-fixed upstream predictions; the segmentation pass switches the box prior from its binary form to the confidence-weighted form of Eq. 1 . This preserves the shared representation.
blocks.zh: 从零开始联合训练这三项任务是不稳定的:检测,密集的分割,图像级CVS对共享编码器提出了相互矛盾的要求,一个弱的探测器为下游头提供了不可靠的输入. 因此,我们分四个阶段建造级联。 (一) 检测:我们仅培训快速R-CNN分支,以建立级联所依赖的本地化和多尺度特征。 (二)检测 - 分解:我们增加分解分支,并与检测一起训练,从预先训练的单任务分解模型中温暖地启动其头部;FPN,双头,适配器,以及ResNet后期更新,而早期则保持冻结. (三)全级级联:我们加CVS头部,将所有三个任务都与激活的耦合器一起训练,因此每个头部都从它所看到的预测的箱和口罩中学习(这个阶段在第2.1节之前使用二进制箱);PCGrad [15]在共享骨干和FPN更新前去掉每个任务梯度上相互矛盾的部分. (四)微调:最后,我们一次对头部进行微调,顺序为级联(检测,分化,CVS). 每趟通过列车只限该车头和它的适配器与其余的冷冻,在现在固定的上游预测上重新校正它;分段通过将前方的车厢从二进制形式切换到置信加权形式Eq. 1. 这保留了共同的代表性。

blocks.en: 2.4 Training Objective
blocks.zh: 2.4 培训目标

blocks.en: Each task head is trained with its own loss; because annotation availability differs by task, each sample contributes only to the losses for which its label is present. Detection uses the Faster R-CNN multi-task loss [ 18 ] , the sum of the region-proposal-network and detection-head classification (cross-entropy) and box-regression (smooth- L 1 L_{1} ) terms, ℒ det = ℒ rpn cls + ℒ rpn reg + ℒ roi cls + ℒ roi reg \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{det}}=\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{cls}}_{\mathrm{rpn}}+\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{reg}}_{\mathrm{rpn}}+\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{cls}}_{\mathrm{roi}}+\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{reg}}_{\mathrm{roi}} . blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: Dataset. We evaluate on Endoscapes2023, a publicly available laparoscopic cholecystectomy dataset with aligned annotations for object detection, semantic segmentation, and CVS assessment [ 1 , 2 ] . The dataset contains 201 videos with an official video-level split of 120 training, 41 validation, and 40 test videos. CVS labels, taken as the consensus of three expert annotators, are available for 11,090 frames, bounding boxes for 1,933 frames, and public semantic masks for the Endoscapes-Seg50 subset. Detection and segmentation use the same six foreground classes; segmentation additionally includes background. The safety-critical anatomy is both rare and hard to localise: on the test split, the cystic plate and hepatocystic triangle appear in only 41.7% and 39.7% of frames, and their detection mAP is 8–19, compared with over 60 for the gallbladder and surgical instrument [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价了Endoscapes2023,这是一个可公开查阅的腹腔胆囊切除数据集,其中附有用于物体检测、语义分解和CVS评估的对齐说明[1,2]。 该数据集包含201个视频,官方视频一级分录120个培训,41个验证,40个测试视频. CVS标签,作为三位专家注释家的共识,可供11,090帧,1,933帧的边框,以及Endoscapes-Seg50子集的公共语义口罩使用. 探测和分解使用相同的六个前缘类;分解还包含背景. 安全临界解剖法既罕见,也难于定位:在测试分解时,囊泡板和肝细胞三角只出现在41.7%和39.7%的帧中,它们的检测mAP为8–19,而胆囊和外科仪器则超过60个[1].

blocks.en: Metrics. Detection is evaluated with COCO-style bounding-box mAP@[0.5:0.95]. Segmentation is evaluated with semantic mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) over the seven classes. CVS is evaluated by average precision per criterion and mean AP over C1–C3; balanced accuracy uses thresholds calibrated on the validation split and applied to the held-out test split. Because these structures are the safety-critical bottleneck, we additionally report rare detection mAP and rare segmentation mIoU over the cystic plate and hepatocystic triangle. Since our segmentation metric is semantic mIoU rather than the official Endoscapes instance-segmentation AP, segmentation comparisons are restricted to our own framework-matched baselines.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 检测用COCO式的边框-box mAP@[0.5:0.95]来评价. 分化用语义平均交叉-交叉(mIoU)来评价这7类. CVS按每个标准的平均精度和平均AP大于C1-C3来评价;平衡精度使用在验证分值上校准的阈值,并应用于搁置测试分值. 由于这些结构是安全的关键瓶颈,我们额外报告稀有检测mAP和稀有分解mIoU在囊面板和肝细胞三角形之上. 由于我们的分解度量是语义上的mIoU而不是官方的Endoscapes实例分解AP,分解比较仅限于我们自己的框架匹配基线.

blocks.en: Baselines. The primary controls are framework-matched single-task learning (STL) baselines for detection, segmentation, and CVS, each using the same ResNet-50–FPN encoder and corresponding task head as the proposed model. For CVS, we also compare against published LG-CVS [ 9 ] and SV2LSTG [ 10 ] benchmark results under the same public annotation setting. We do not compare against results using the private Endoscapes-Seg201 annotations, which are not publicly available.
blocks.zh: 基线。 主要控制是框架匹配的单任务学习(STL)基线,用于检测,分割,和CVS,每个都使用相同的ResNet-50-FPN编码器和相应的任务头作为拟议模型. 对于CVS,我们还比较了在同一公共注释设置下发布的LG-CVS[9]和SV2LSTG[10]基准结果. 我们不使用非公开的Endoscapes-Seg201说明来比较结果,这些说明是不公开的。

blocks.en: Implementation details. We implement all models in PyTorch. A shared preprocessing pipeline applies the same geometric transforms to images, boxes, and masks. During training, the input scale is sampled from 854 × 480 854\times 480 , 1024 × 576 1024\times 576 , and 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 at a fixed aspect ratio, and evaluation is bounded by 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 . Semantic masks are resized by nearest neighbour, images are normalised with ImageNet statistics, and augmentation is horizontal flip, translation, colour jitter, and cutout.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 我们在PyTorch执行所有的模型. 共享预处理管道对图像、盒和口罩采用相同的几何转换。 在训练期间,输入尺度从854×480 854\时,1024×576 1024\时,576,1280×720 1280\时,720按固定宽度比进行抽样,评价范围为1280×720 1280\时. 语义口罩由最近的邻居调整大小,图像与ImageNet统计实现正常化,增强是水平翻转,翻译,色彩焦急,剪切.

blocks.en: The full cascade trains with SGD (learning rate 0.0015 0.0015 , momentum 0.9 0.9 , weight decay 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , batch size 2) for up to 16 epochs with validation-based checkpointing, freezing all but the last two ResNet stages and disabling mixed precision; the detection, segmentation, and CVS fine-tuning stages use learning rate 0.0008 0.0008 for up to 12, 12, and 6 epochs. At inference, Faster R-CNN applies class-wise NMS at 0.5 0.5 , score threshold 0.05 0.05 , and at most 100 detections per image; the segmentation prior follows Section 2.1 . Runtime and memory profiling are left for future deployment-oriented evaluation.
blocks.zh: 装有SGD的全级级列车(学习速率0.00150.015,动力0.90.9,重量衰变5×10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4},批量尺寸2),最高可达16个以验证为基础的检查时间段,除最后两个ResNet阶段外,冻结所有两个阶段,使混合精度失效;检测,分化和CVS微调阶段使用学习速率0.00080.0008,最高可达12、12和6个时间段. 推论,更快的R-CNN在0.5 0.5分,分数阈值0.050.05分,每个图像最多100次检测时适用级次的NMS;之前的区划遵循2.1节. 运行时间和内存剖面分析留给今后的部署评价。

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Comparison with single-task and published methods. Table 4 reports test performance. Relative to single-task learning, the staged cascade improves every head: detection rises from 29.6 to 32.0, segmentation of the rare anatomy from 4.6 to 15.3 mIoU, and CVS from 47.9 to 67.2 mAP. The detection branch alone reaches 32.0 mAP, competitive with the strongest published detector on Endoscapes, Deformable-DETR (32.7), and above Faster R-CNN (30.0) [ 1 ] . The CVS mAP of 67.2 exceeds both the single-frame LG-CVS (63.2) and the spatiotemporal SV2LSTG (64.3) under the same public annotation setting, and the balanced accuracy of 74.7 is on par with LG-CVS (74.8) and above SV2LSTG (73.4). A single-frame model thus matches or surpasses a spatiotemporal one on this benchmark. Figure 3 shows a qualitative comparison on a test frame.
blocks.zh: 与单任务和公布方法的比较. 表4报告测试业绩。 相对于单任务学习,舞台级联改进了每个头:检测从29.6升至32.0,稀有解剖从4.6毫升至15.3毫升,CVS从47.9升至67.2毫升. 单检测分支就达到32.0 mAP,与Endoscapes,Deformable-DETR(32.7)和以上更快的R-CNN(30.0)上最强的发布探测器竞争. [1]. CVS的MAP为67.2,在相同的公开注释设置下,既超过了单帧LG-CVS(63.2),也超过了spatimporal SV2LSTG(64.3),74.7的平衡精度与LG-CVS(74.8)和以上SV2LSTG(73.4)相当. 因此,单一框架模型与这一基准的瞬间模型相吻合或超过瞬间模型。 图3显示对试验框架的质量比较。

Each criterion is marked green ✓ when the prediction is correct and red ✗ when it is wrong, with the reference labels shown under ground truth. STL misses the rare safety-critical anatomy and mispredicts the criteria, whereas Ours recovers the anatomy and matches the reference.

Staging ablation. Table 4 compares the staged schedule against single-stage joint training of the same network, with identical couplings and PCGrad, from scratch. Without staging, detection fails to train (3.9 mAP), leaving the downstream tasks with unreliable localisation cues; rare-anatomy segmentation falls to 0.1 mIoU and CVS to 28.0 mAP. Training detection first is therefore essential for stable cascade training.

blocks.en: Cascade ablation. Table 4 ablates each coupling in turn while keeping the rest of the training recipe fixed. Removing the box-to-mask prior reduces rare-anatomy segmentation from 15.3 to 14.4 mIoU and CVS from 67.2 to 62.1 mAP. This suggests that box guidance helps recover the small hepatocystic structures on which CVS assessment depends, although the full model has slightly lower aggregate segmentation mIoU than this ablated variant (46.8 vs 48.0). Removing the mask-to-CVS coupling is far more damaging to CVS (67.2 to 55.8 mAP), even though this variant attains the highest rare-anatomy mIoU (15.7). Thus, better segmentation alone does not improve CVS unless the classifier is explicitly coupled to the predicted anatomy. The mask-to-CVS coupling is therefore the main contributor to CVS performance, while the two couplings remain complementary rather than redundant. Overall, these couplings improve the downstream tasks only when the detector localises reliably, and cannot compensate for one that has not converged (Table 4 ). Rare anatomy therefore remains the main segmentation bottleneck even in the full model (15.3 vs 46.8 mIoU).
blocks.zh: 连翘b. 表4依次减少每个组合,同时固定其余的训练食谱。 将盒式至掩体前切除,将稀有切除分解从15.3微米U和CVS从67.2微米AP减少到62.1微米AP。 这表明,盒式导线有助于回收CVS评估所依赖的小型肝细胞结构,尽管整个模型的聚合分解mIoU略低于这个膨胀变体(46.8 vs 48.0). 移除口罩至CVS耦合器对CVS(67.2至55.8 mAP)的破坏要大得多,尽管这种变体达到最高的稀有解剖学mIoU(15.7). 因此,单靠更好的分解并不能改善CVS,除非分类器与预测解剖学明确结合. 因此,口罩对CVS耦合是CVS性能的主要贡献者,而两种耦合仍然是互补而非多余的. 总的来说,只有当探测器可靠地定位时,这些组合才能改进下游任务,而且无法补偿尚未趋同的任务(表4)。 因此,即使在完整的模型(15.3对46.8 mIoU)中,稀有解剖学仍然是主要的分化瓶颈.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: CasCVS-Net combines the complementary tasks of detection, segmentation, and CVS assessment: detection localises anatomy, segmentation produces masks, and a mask-pooled head assesses the three criteria. The staged cascade improves all tasks over single-task baselines, with the largest gain in rare-anatomy segmentation (4.6 to 15.3 mIoU). Its 67.2 CVS mAP exceeds single-frame LG-CVS and spatiotemporal SV2LSTG by 4.0 and 2.9 points, respectively (6.3% and 4.5% relative); ablations identify mask-to-CVS coupling as the main contributor. The method requires a converged detector and processes frames independently; rare anatomy remains hardest to segment. Next steps are temporal modelling and multi-centre validation.
blocks.zh: CasCVS-Net结合了检测,分化,和CVS评估的互补任务:检测局部解剖,分化产生口罩,一个口罩集合头评估三个标准. 该级联在单任务基线上改进了所有任务,在稀有解剖分解(4.6至15.3 mIoU)中收益最大. 它的67.2 CVS mAP分别以4.0和2.9点(相对6.3%和4.5%)超过单帧LG-CVS和spatimporal SV2LSTG;bloods确定面具-CVS耦合为主要贡献者. 该方法需要一个集中的探测器和独立的处理帧;罕见的解剖学仍然最难分解. 接下来的步骤是时间建模和多中心验证.
